scoped_decisions.statement: For T>1, slicing a row-major[T,1024] fused projection into two[T,512] column views yields row stride1024. Existing pool/ring helper requires contiguous row stride512; cannot pass these views unchanged.
scoped_decisions.limits: Does not exclude two contiguous outputs, stride-aware consumers or unpacking; no measured performance gain.

scoped_decisions.statement: Pool may read old ring values before update; tail new writes can target the same32-slot ring. Preserve request/page/slot/version ordering and original FP32 projected values.
scoped_decisions.limits: Witnesses are hypothetical source semantics, not observed conflicts; disjoint states may permit overlap, not universal whole-kernel serialization.

scoped_decisions.statement: Channel-specific weighted pool and subsequent512-channel RMS require complete pooled statistics; input per-token sums of squares alone do not determine pooled RMS. Preserve pooled BF16 rounding and zero/incomplete rows.
scoped_decisions.limits: Does not preclude exact channel accumulation or fused row reduction; resource/consumer closure remains open.

scoped_decisions.statement: Index key and scale must be mutually consistent before QLI; long-KV before its attention reader. Index projection reads pre-long-RoPE latent, so cross-stream long mutation needs actual read completion or nonmutating representation.
scoped_decisions.limits: No actual slot/tensor/event identity measured; static source layer consumers do not prove every row is read.

scoped_decisions.statement: Pool output is token-aligned with completed-group rows, separate physical compressed slots and source positions. Cannot infer valid completed rows or simply remove half postprocessing from physical M or ratio2.
scoped_decisions.limits: A compact valid-row variant needs actual validity/mapping, zero-row observability, duplicate slots, scales, cache lifetime and graph-address contracts.

scoped_decisions.statement: Long F22/F17 gaps lack EVENT WAIT-like TASK labels in this DB; short F22 interval overlaps WAIT records on other streams. Host API gaps differ from device gaps and are not directly convertible.
scoped_decisions.limits: No physical idle, absent communication, runtime scheduling cause, or removable time is proved; unexported work/other processes and capture contracts remain open.

joint_C2_interface_model.domain: Conditional row-independent projections before equal-size gather; preserve SWA BF16, both compressor FP32 outputs, ring/metadata/layout and numerical contracts
joint_C2_interface_model.limits: Pure conditional interface byte accounting, not network/HBM traffic, a universal lower bound, measured savings or2x speedup. Packing/call overhead, weight/row ownership and changed-M numerical effects unproved. C1 is a separate graph.
